purpose: HTML and JavaScript string escaping utilities used when embedding dynamic content in generated HTML documents.
called_by: MarkdownRenderer.cpp — title escaping, base href escaping
invariants: EscapeScriptString escapes \, ', \r, \n, <, >, &, U+2028, U+2029 for safe embedding in JS string literals
gotchas: EscapeScriptString uses \u003c and \u003e for < and > (Unicode escapes, not HTML entities) to prevent </script> injection in inline scripts
